name: Julian Hard Cider
notes: 4 photos, none are Julian Hard Cider's own food board. 1.jpg and 2.jpg are printed menus for two co-located food vendors at the same address (Poppy's American Grill, Colt's Burger Bar — inside the Julian Station shopping arcade at 4470 Julian Rd), both legible; dishes below are transcribed from those. 3.jpg and 4.jpg are the cidery's own chalkboard cider-flight/pricing boards — drink-only, skipped per rules.
